#include <array>

using namespace std;

typedef int64_t ll;
typedef uint64_t ull;

const int N = 250005, M = 1 << 17, D = 18;

int P;
int power(int a, int t) {
	int r = 1;
	while (t) {
		if (t & 1) r = (ll)r * a % P;
		a = (ll)a * a % P;
		t >>= 1;
	}
	return r;
}

int L, K, fac[N], n, m, bit[20], ifac[N], bitcnt[N];
ll suma[D][M], sumc[D][M];
ull dp[D][M], tmp[D][M];

	cin >> L >> K >> P;
	fac[0] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
		fac[i] = (ll)fac[i - 1] * i % P;
		bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
	}
	ll all = power(K, L);
	if (L & 1) {
		cout << all << endl;
		return 0;
	}

	for (int i = L; i >= 1; i--) ifac[i - 1] = (ll)ifac[i] * i % P;
	for (int i = 1; (1 << i) <= L; i++) if (L >> i & 1) bit[n++] = 1 << i;

	m = 1 << n;
	// build a
	for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
		int s = 0;
		for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (i >> j & 1) s += bit[j];
		suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = ifac[s];
	}

	for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
		int i, j, k, l;
		ll* a = suma[t];
		for (l = m; l >= 2; l >>= 1) for (j = 0; j < m; j += l) for (k = 0; k < l / 2; k++) a[j + k + l] += a[j + k];
		for (j = 0; j < m; j++) a[j] %= P;
	}

	for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) memcpy(dp[t], suma[t], m * sizeof(ll));
	int cc = 0, revK = 0;
	while (K) {
		revK = (revK << 1) | (K & 1);
		cc++;
		K >>= 1;
	}
	for (cc--, revK >>= 1; cc; cc--, revK >>= 1) {

		// use dp to update dp
		// f i,j means V = i, P = j
		// f (a + b),j = ∑g a,j * h b,j

		for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) memset(tmp[t], 0, m * sizeof(ll));
		for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; b++) {
			ull* f = tmp[a + b], * g = dp[a], * h = dp[b];
			for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
		}
		for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P;

		if (revK & 1) {
			// use suma to update dp

			for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) memset(tmp[t], 0, m * sizeof(ll));
			for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; b++) {
				ull* f = tmp[a + b], * g = dp[a]; ll h = suma[b];
				for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
			}
			for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P;
		}
	}

	// get answer
	for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) memcpy(sumc[t], dp[t], m * sizeof(ll));
	for (int t = 0; t <= n; t++) {
		int i, j, k, l;
		ll* a = sumc[t];
		for (l = 2; l <= m; l <<= 1) for (j = 0; j < m; j += l) for (k = 0; k < l / 2; k++) a[j + k + l] -= a[j + k];
		for (j = 0; j < m; j++) a[j] = (a[j] % P + P) % P;
	}

	ll ans = (all - sumc[n][(1 << n) - 1] * fac[L] % P + P) % P;
	cout << ans << endl;

	return 0;
}
